Matches fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=show/portrait-dialog UI). No address residue in the name.
purpose: Display a portrait + dialog scene for one ending-epilogue line and block until the player presses a key, then close the dialog panel.
logic_summary: Linear, no branches (cyclomatic 1). params.name: text_idx
params.semantics: Dialog page/entry index into the active chapter dialog text block; forwarded as fd2_display_dialog_scene's page_idx (start narrative chunk within data_fd2_current_chapter_text).
params.reason: Body uses param_2 only as the page/index argument to fd2_display_dialog_scene; confirmed via disasm (PUSH [ESP+0x28]=param_2 -> 2nd arg of fd2_display_dialog_scene).
